button.title: Button
button.visual: review component variants, spacing and content against the reference
button.accessibility: accessible name, button role and disabled state
button.motion: press and release with normal and reduced motion

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.visual: review selected and disabled state against the reference
tabs.behavior: skip the disabled tab, select the next available tab and update the panel
tabs.accessibility: selected and disabled states, panel association and traversal order
tabs.motion: selection indicator or panel transitions where present

popover.title: Popover
popover.visual: review trigger and panel chrome; the CMP Desktop open fixture omits the upstream form, which needs its own capture
popover.behavior: open, dismiss and return focus to the trigger
popover.accessibility: panel content is reachable while open and absent after dismissal
popover.motion: enter and exit with normal and reduced motion
